method: Weighted implementation estimate: sum(task percentage × scope weight) ÷ sum(scope weight). Weights are manually assigned scope points (1 small, 2 moderate, 3 substantial, 5 complex), not hours or validated effort forecasts. Scores are 0/25/50/75/100 and describe source coverage, not acceptance or release readiness. A 100% task is narrowly implemented in source and still unverified at runtime. All phases are included in the overall estimate. V2 source coverage selects existing private mesh/VPN connectivity as the optional relay alternative. Source completion does not imply the unfinished V1 product, mobile store release, or runtime acceptance is complete.
